recipes.projection: TwoGun mode: Proj is TwoGun's own DraftKings projection for the 290 players he projects (board updated Sun, Nov 22, 11:52 AM ET), used exactly as he publishes it; his game lines replace ESPN's where he has one. The other 214 players keep the current projection: Blended projection = weighted mean of Sleeper app x1, FantasyPros x1, CBS Sports x1, ESPN fantasy x1, DraftKings points converted from each source's own stat lines. Weights renormalise over the sources that cover each player; coverage is the covering weight as a share of the total enabled weight. Coverage under 50% keeps the number from the sources that do cover the player and is flagged "thin"; it is never pulled toward a typical score for the salary. No coverage leaves the projection blank, flagged "no projection", unless the injury report lists the player as out, on IR, doubtful or suspended, in which case the projection is 0.

injury.comment: Gibbs rushed 23 times for 98 yards and two touchdowns and secured four of five targets for 20 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Gibbs unsurprisingly had his work cut out for him against the Buccaneers' typically stingy run defense, but the Lions had the luxury of continuing to pound Gibbs into the line while protecting a second-half lead. Gibbs eventually broke through for a game-long 26-yard run and cashed in with one- and four-yard touchdown runs in the fourth quarter to help ice the victory. While Gibbs fell just short of his fifth 100-yard effort in the last six games, the 2023 first-round pick is up to 13 rushing touchdowns and is averaging 5.0 yards per carry heading into a Thanksgiving Day home showdown against the Bears.

injury.comment: Walker (groin) was listed as a non-participant on Monday's practice estimate.
injury.longComment: Since the Chiefs are coming off a 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday, the team held a walk-through Monday in preparation for Thursday's game against the Bills.  Nate Taylor of ESPN.com previously reported that the Chiefs were "optimistic" that Walker could be available for the team's Thanksgiving night contest, but with one 'DNP' now on the books, the running back has two more opportunities to log any listed level of practice participation before the team posts its Week 12 game statuses.

injury.comment: Lamb brought 11 of 12 targets for 132 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Lamb's near-perfect day included his fifth 100-yard effort of the season -- including his second in the last three games -- and his ninth touchdown grab, which came from eight yards out early in the second quarter. Lamb had six double-digit-yardage catches overall on the afternoon, including his game-long 29-yard grab in the first half. Lamb crossed the 1,000-yard mark for the sixth consecutive season in the process, and he'll take an 88-1,108-9 line into a Week 12 Thanksgiving Day clash at home against the Eagles.

injury.comment: St. Brown brought in five of six targets for 37 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
injury.longComment: St. Brown set the pace for the Lions in catches while also tying for the team lead in targets, and the sure-handed receiver also recorded his eighth touchdown reception of the season on a 14-yard grab early in the second quarter that opened the scoring for either team. St. Brown's yardage total left plenty to be desired, but he's still up to a 70-792-8 line on 97 targets heading into Thursday's holiday showdown at home against the Bears.

injury.comment: Cook rushed 22 times for 89 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for three yards in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
injury.longComment: Cook extended his touchdown streak to nine games with a one-yard touchdown run in the second quarter. He accounted for all but five of Buffalo's rushing attempts as Josh Allen finished without one, but Cook came up short of 100 scrimmage yards for the first time since Week 4. The reigning NFL rushing yards leader continues to put up stellar production heading into Thursday night's home game against the Chiefs.

injury.comment: Allen completed 27 of 45 passes for 304 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
injury.longComment: Allen threw a four-yard touchdown pass to DJ Moore in the second quarter but got picked off twice later in the first half and had a would-be third interception nullified by a penalty on the penultimate play before halftime. Despite some sloppy play and zero rushing production from Allen, the 9-1 Bills cruised past the 1-9 Dolphins as the star QB raised his season total to 25 touchdowns (14 passing, 11 rushing). Buffalo's likely to encounter more resistance Thursday night against the 8-2 Chiefs. Allen is 5-1 against Patrick Mahomes in the regular season but 0-4 when they face off in the playoffs.

injury.comment: Hubbard carried the ball 27 times for 120 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens. He added a two-point conversion.
injury.longComment: The 27-year-old running back continues to shine, making two trips to the end zone for a second straight week and piling up at least 120 rushing yards for the third time in 2026. Hubbard is handling a bell-cow workload with no issues, and over six games since the Panthers' bye he's averaging nearly 25 touches a game while amassing 688 scrimmage yards and six rushing touchdowns. Jonathon Brooks (groin) seems close to coming off IR, but but he's unlikely to make much of a dent in Hubbard's role as long as the team's top RB is dominating. Hubbard faces a very tough test in Week 12 against a Tampa Bay defense that held him to just 60 combined yards and zero TDs in their first meeting in Week 7.

injury.comment: Flowers caught eight of 11 targets for 97 yards in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
injury.longComment: No other Raven caught more than four passes or saw more than six targets as Flowers continues to build chemistry with new quarterback Jacoby Brissett. The fourth-year wideout has posted a 14-171-0 line on 18 targets in Brissett's first two starts for Baltimore, immediately establishing a strong floor. Flowers will try to keep rolling in Week 12 against what has been a surprisingly vulnerable Texans defense.

injury.comment: Williams rushed 18 times for 67 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for 24 yards and another score in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Williams continued his highly fantasy-friendly season with his third multi-touchdown showing of the season. The veteran back first struck from one yard out to cap off the opening possession of the game, and he added his second scoring grab of 2026 on an 11-yard catch early in the third quarter. Williams has over 60 rushing yards in three straight games, and he's up to 10 rush TDs, his second double-digit tally in as many seasons, heading into Thursday's home divisional Thanksgiving clash with the Eagles.

injury.comment: questionable

tg.callText: [lean] Bowers sat out Wednesday's practice but was limited Thursday and Friday, and the final report on Fri Nov 20 lists him as Questionable with no downgrade, even though he said only "We'll see" about playing.

injury.comment: Olave caught nine of 15 targets for 102 yards in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
injury.longComment: One week after taking a back seat to rookie Jordyn Tyson, Olave re-emerged as Tyler Shough's favorite downfield option, as he set a new season high in targets and topped 100 receiving yards for the fourth time in 2026. Tyson, meanwhile, caught only one pass on two targets, suggesting the Saints' aerial attack may not be able to support both wideouts in the same game. Olave will look to make an impact again in Week 12 against the Bengals.

injury.comment: Nabers brought in seven of 12 targets for 55 yards and a touchdown in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Nabers was in the familiar position of leading the Giants across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets, and the third-year star also snapped a four-game touchdown drought with an eight-yard grab in the second quarter. Nabers has at least five catches in eight straight contests and three double-digit target tallies within that span, and the 2024 first-round pick should continue to be the subject of plenty of J.J. McCarthy's attention in a Week 12 road matchup against the Colts next Sunday.

injury.comment: Irving rushed 18 times for 68 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 32 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Irving worked hard all afternoon against a feisty Lions defense, and outside of his game-long 23-yard run, he scuffled to 45 yards on 17 carries. Irving worked around a hard shot to the abdomen that he sustained in the second half, and he did manage to contribute a rushing touchdown for the fourth straight game when he went in from one yard out in the latter portion of the third quarter. Irving has now equaled a career high with eight rushing touchdowns, and he's 107 yards short of his second career 1,000-yard season on the ground heading into a Week 12 home matchup against the Panthers on Monday night, Nov. 30.

injury.comment: Swift carried the ball 13 times for 51 yards and caught both his targets for eight yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.
injury.longComment: The Bears' offense looked a little sluggish coming out of its bye, and Swift wound up leading the backfield in scrimmage yards on the afternoon, highlighting his performance with a three-yard TD pass from Caleb Williams in the second quarter. Swift's 15 touches also led the backfield, as a returning Kyle Monangai got eased back into action with eight touches. Surprisingly, Salvon Ahmed also handled six carries, all in the fourth quarter when the game seemed well in hand. Swift did lose his third fumble of the season, a new career high, but the TD was his 11th of the year, also a new personal best. Monangai could see his workload increase as he puts his turf toe injury further behind him, but Swift seems to have a firm hold of the No. 1 job heading into a Week 12 clash with the team that drafted him in 2020, the Lions.

injury.comment: McMillan caught six of nine targets for 71 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens.
injury.longComment: The second-year wideout posted his best yardage total since Week 6 while leading the Panthers in receiving yards, catches and targets. McMillan capped his solid performance with a seven-yard TD from Bryce Young in the second quarter. McMillan has slowed down since a torrid start to the season, but he still sports a 55-731-4 line on 87 targets through 10 games heading into a Week 12 clash with the Buccaneers.

injury.comment: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said Tuten aggravated a right ankle injury in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants, noting that an examination Monday revealed nothing "too bad," Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.
injury.longComment: Tuten carried 10 times for 33 yards and recorded three receptions for 20 yards before exiting the contest with 3:40 remaining, when his ankle got stepped on for the second time that day. Though the injury was to the same ankle/foot that has resulted in Tuten being listed on the Jacksonville injury report for three straight weeks, Coen seemed to imply that the aggravation isn't viewed as a major concern. Even so, Tuten's practice activity is likely to be affected in Week 12, putting his availability for next Sunday's game against the Titans in question.

tg.callText: [strong] Yahoo Sports (Nov 18) still lists Tuten with the foot/ankle injury from Week 8. He got a heavy workload last Sunday and played in Week 9 without practicing, so a limited practice Wednesday is a better sign than in past weeks. injury.comment: Pickens secured seven of 10 targets for 102 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Pickens played second fiddle to CeeDee Lamb (11-132-1) in Sunday's blowout win, but that still equated to a rewarding effort for the franchise-tagged receiver. The game marked Pickens' third 100-yard tally of the season and second straight, and he now has seen double-digit targets in four of the last six games overall. Pickens rounded out his day Sunday with his sixth touchdown reception of the campaign on a 10-yard catch in the latter portion of the second quarter, and he should be teed up for another busy day when the Cowboys host the Eagles for a Week 12 matchup on Thanksgiving Day.

injury.comment: Prescott completed 28 of 33 passes for 325 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions and added four carries for nine yards and another score in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.
injury.longComment: As the final score and Prescott's numbers indicate, the prolific passer was clicking on all cylinders right out of the gate against an overmatched Titans defense. Prescott had already helped stake the Cowboys to a 27-6 lead by halftime with eight- and 10-yard touchdown strikes to CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens, respectively. Prescott struck again through the air in the second half with an 11-yard touchdown pass to Javonte Williams before closing out his touchdown tally with a two-yard toss to Brevyn Spann-Ford with just under five minutes remaining. Prescott added his second rushing touchdown of the campaign on a two-yard run in the latter portion of the third quarter, giving him his second straight five-TD performance. Prescott is up to 3,049 passing yards and a 25:6 TD:INT heading into a Thanksgiving Day home clash with the Eagles in Week 12.

injury.comment: Henry cleared concussion protocol and was made available to the media following Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers, Giana Han of the Baltimore Banner reports.
injury.longComment: Henry was checked for a concussion in the fourth quarter of the contest, but evidently passed all tests. Prior to his exit, Henry carried 13 times for 94 yards and a touchdown and hauled in four of his five targets for 17 yards. He also lost his second fumble of the season. Henry looks like he'll be ready to handle his normal role as the lead option out of the Baltimore backfield next Sunday against the Texans.

injury.comment: Washington secured eight of 17 targets for 103 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Washington led the Jaguars across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets, and his day could have been even better had what appeared to be an acrobatic touchdown catch in the back of the end zone early in the fourth quarter not been ruled incomplete. Washington still made several tough grabs throughout the afternoon against a stingy Giants secondary, and he now has consecutive 100-yard efforts for the first time in 2026. Washington needs just 100 receiving yards to eclipse his career high of 847 heading into a very favorable Week 12 home matchup against the Titans next Sunday.

injury.comment: Lawrence completed 25 of 47 passes for 301 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions and rushed three times for seven yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday. He also fumbled twice but recovered.
injury.longComment: Lawrence just managed to generate his fourth 300-yard effort of the season, but the yardage came on a season-high number of pass attempts and season-low completion percentage. The Giants' notoriously stingy pass defense frequently stymied the Jaguars' typically efficient air attack, and Lawrence threw multiple interceptions for the first time this season. Lawrence did have what seemed to be a second-half touchdown pass to Parker Washington in the back of the end zone ruled incomplete and surprisingly confirmed as such on replay, but the 2021 first overall pick will be looking to get back to his mistake-free ways in a favorable Week 12 home matchup with a Titans team he threw for a season-high 352 yards against in Week 10.

injury.comment: Warren rushed nine times for 28 yards and caught two of three targets for one yard in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
injury.longComment: Warren finished with 29 yards on 11 touches compared to 34 yards on nine touches for Rico Dowdle, as Pittsburgh's backfield duo was held quiet for a second consecutive game. After recording at least 73 scrimmage yards in eight consecutive games to start the season, Warren has produced just 75 yards without a touchdown over the past two games. Warren and Dowdle should continue to split backfield touches Friday against the Broncos.

injury.comment: McBride caught nine of 14 targets for 54 yards in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City. He added four yards on his only carry.
injury.longComment: Working with his fourth quarterback of the season in Josh Johnson, McBride dominated the 40-year-old's attention, as no other Cardinal got more than seven targets or hauled in more than four passes. The star tight end wasn't able to do much with the volume, however, as his longest gain went for a mere nine yards. Carson Beck (back) could be back under center in Week 12 against the Commanders, but that might not improve McBride's outlook, as he saw only five targets in Week 10 during the rookie QB's first NFL start.

injury.comment: Mahomes completed 27 of 39 passes for 324 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Mahomes was clicking early against the Cardinals' defense, capping off the opening possession of the game with an eight-yard touchdown toss to Travis Kelce. The prolific signal-caller went on to add a 22-yard scoring pass to Kelce shortly before the end of the first half, and he capped off his day with an 18-yarder to Xavier Worthy on which the speedy receiver raced up the right sideline and into the end zone. Mahomes now has consecutive 300-yard efforts and has accomplished the feat in three of the past four games overall, affording him plenty of momentum heading into a Week 12 showdown with Josh Allen and the Bills on Thanksgiving night.

injury.comment: Pollard rushed 21 times for 110 yards and failed to bring in his only target in the Titans' 51-30 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Pollard eclipsed the century mark on the ground for the third time in the last four games, lighting up his old team for multiple productive gains on the afternoon. The veteran back has been a bright spot in a dismal 1-9 start for Tennessee, despite game script often working against the ground attack in the second halves of the Titans' contests. Pollard remains firmly on pace for a fifth straight 1,000-yard season heading into a Week 12 road matchup against the Jaguars next Sunday.

injury.comment: Smith (hamstring) caught five of 12 targets for 41 yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
injury.longComment: Smith was targeted on 12 of Joe Milton's 21 passes in the wide receiver's first game since Week 6. Milton has thrown for just 310 yards without a touchdown pass through two starts for the Eagles, so expectations should be tempered for the team's passing game as a whole, but Smith has reclaimed his role as the team's top pass catcher. Smith could make the most of his hefty target share Thursday against the generous Dallas secondary.

injury.comment: Wilson caught three of five targets for 39 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
injury.longComment: Wilson led the team in receiving yards and targets as Geno Smith threw for just 176 yards, though Wilson wasn't on the receiving end of any of Smith's three touchdown passes. The Jets' No. 1 wideout hasn't scored since Week 5, and Wilson has fallen short of 45 receiving yards four times this season, though he has also topped 100 yards three times. Wilson will face a Dolphins defense in Week 12 that held him to a season-low 26 receiving yards in their Week 7 meeting.

injury.comment: Williams completed 15 of 23 passes for 181 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints. He added 11 rushing yards on four carries.
injury.longComment: The Bears' offense looked a little sluggish coming out of its bye, and both of Williams' TD passes came in the second quarter as he connected with D'Andre Swift on a three-yard shovel pass and Colston Loveland on a 15-yard score. Williams failed to reach 200 passing yards for the first time since Week 2, and he'll take a somewhat disappointing 10:6 TD:INT through seven games into a Week 12 clash with the Lions.

injury.comment: Coleman reeled off 111 yards and three touchdowns on 24 carries and hauled in four of five targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 38-24 win against the Raiders.
injury.longComment: Since returning from an IR stint due to a sprained ankle in Week 7, Coleman has increased his touch count in four consecutive contests, taking a stranglehold on the Broncos backfield in the process. As evidence, his 25 touches easily outpaced fellow RB J.K. Dobbins' one, which went for no yards. Coleman, a rookie fourth-round pick, also cracked the 100-yard mark on the ground for the first time in his career. With RJ Harvey (ankle) on injured reserve for at least one more game, Coleman again is set to act as a workhorse in Friday's road matchup with the Steelers.

injury.comment: Burden caught two of three targets for 10 yards and added three yards on his only carry in Sunday's 21-13 win over New Orleans.
injury.longComment: It was the worst performance of the season for Burden, who suffered a concussion in the Bears' last game in Week 9 but used a bye week to clear the protocol and avoid missing any additional time. The second-year wideout saw his three-game scoring streak come to an end, and on the season he sports a 51-654-4 line on 69 targets through 10 contests. Burden will look to bounce back in a potential Week 12 barn burner against the Lions.

injury.comment: Goff completed 20 of 28 passes for 279 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding five rushes for 12 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Goff put together an efficient effort on an afternoon when he recorded completions to eight different targets. The veteran signal-caller hit Amon-Ra St. Brown (14 yards) and Jameson Williams (57 yards) for his pair of touchdown passes, and he has multiple scoring strikes in two straight. Goff boasts a sparkling 20:4 TD:INT heading into a Thanksgiving Day showdown against the Bears at Ford Field on Thursday.

injury.comment: Barkley was listed as a limited participant on Monday's estimated practice report due to a neck injury and an illness.
injury.longComment: Barkley appeared to be nursing a left arm injury in the aftermath of Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers, but it was instead two different health concerns that resulted in him being included on the Eagles' first Week 12 injury report. The Eagles are facing a quick turnaround this week with a Thursday matchup against the Cowboys, so Barkley could be in line for only light activity over the next two days as the team aims to keep him as fresh as possible for that contest. Head coach Nick Sirianni hasn't yet offered any indication that Barkley is in jeopardy of sitting out Thanksgiving Day.

injury.comment: Rice secured all six targets for 53 yards in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Rice tied for the team lead in receptions and finished as the runner-up in targets to Travis Kelce. The veteran receiver averaged a modest 8.8 yards per catch, his third game in the last four with under 10.0 yards per reception. Rice has at least five catches in four consecutive contests heading into Thursday's Week 12 Thanksgiving showdown against the Bills in Buffalo.

injury.comment: Johnson rushed 23 times for 105 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 38 yards in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Making a second consecutive start in place of Kenneth Walker (groin), Johnson once again provided starter-quality production as both a runner and receiver. The rookie also added his second career rushing TD on a three-yard run late in the first quarter, making it an all-around rewarding fantasy day. The Chiefs expect Walker to be ready to return for a Thanksgiving night showdown against the Bills in four days, but even if that comes to pass, Johnson has likely earned himself a larger role for the stretch run with his performance the last two contests.

injury.comment: Moore caught eight of 10 targets for 91 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
injury.longComment: Moore's four-yard touchdown catch in the second quarter gave him his first multi-game regular-season touchdown streak since Weeks 15 and 16 of the 2025 campaign with the Bears. He briefly left the game later in the first half to have his knee looked at but promptly returned and ultimately reached the 90-yard threshold for a second consecutive game while leading the team in targets. Barring a setback with his knee on a short week, Moore should continue to work as Buffalo's top wide receiver Thanksgiving night against the Chiefs.

injury.comment: Hall rushed 20 times for 86 yards while catching all three of his targets for 14 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
injury.longComment: Hall reached 100 scrimmage yards for the second consecutive game while scoring his first touchdown since Week 1 on a seven-yard reception in the second quarter. Both Hall and Braelon Allen (17 touches for 84 yards) were heavily involved as the Jets snapped a five-game losing streak and were able to stick with the ground game. Hall has 56 touches to Allen's 36 in three games since the former returned from a quadriceps injury. After dropping the Chargers to 1-9 with Sunday's win, Hall and the Jets will face the 1-9 Dolphins in Week 12.

injury.comment: Williams brought in all four targets for 93 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
injury.longComment: The highlight of Williams' afternoon was a 57-yard touchdown reception early in the third quarter where he got free on a post pattern, and the fifth-year veteran also led the Lions in receiving yards. Williams has at least four receptions in four of the last five games, and Sunday marked his third game with more than 90 receiving yards. The 2022 first-round pick is now averaging 17.0 yards per reception heading into Thursday's Week 12 home matchup against the Bears.

injury.comment: Shough completed 25 of 42 passes for 222 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears. He added 34 rushing yards on three carries.
injury.longComment: Despite the high volume of attempts, Shough couldn't get much going through the air while dealing with a ferocious Chicago pass rush that sacked him six times, including one for a fourth-quarter safety by Montez Sweat. Shough has gone four straight games without producing multiple TDs, posting a 4:3 TD:INT over that stretch while completing 67.3 percent of his passes with a weak 6.3 YPA. The second-year QB will likely need to be a lot more productive in Week 12 if the Saints are going to keep up with Joe Burrow and the Bengals.

injury.comment: Skattebo rushed 14 times for 34 yards and brought in three of seven targets for 14 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
injury.longComment: Skattebo was unsurprisingly stymied on the ground by the Jaguars' elite run defense, and he couldn't really make up for it with his work through the air. Skattebo also committed another untimely turnover, fumbling at Jacksonville's 31-yard line with just over four minutes remaining in the third quarter and New York trying to add to a 20-6 lead. The change of possession ultimately didn't lead to any Jaguars points, however, and head coach John Harbaugh showed some faith in the second-year back by affording him the opportunity to ice the upset win with three carries on the final drive. Skattebo proved up to the task by netting 13 yards on those touches to force the Jags to exhaust their timeouts, and he should continue helming the backfield in a Week 12 road matchup against the Colts next Sunday.

injury.comment: Hrad coach Dave Canales said Monday that Coker has been cleared from the concussion protocol, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.
injury.longComment: Coker endured a helmet-to-helmet hit at the end of a six-yard catch in the fourth quarter of Sunday's win against the Ravens, getting shaken up in the process. Afterward, be reportedly entered the concussion protocol, but one day later he doesn't have a head injury. Coker thus is in the clear ahead of next Monday's game at Tampa Bay.

injury.comment: Young completed 22 of 30 passes for 254 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 35-33 win over Baltimore.
injury.longComment: The fourth-year QB posted his best single-game completion rate of the season (73.3 percent) while tossing multiple TDs for the third time in the last six contests, a stretch in which he's compiled a 9:5 TD:INT. Both of Young's scores came in the first half, as he connected with Mitchell Evans on a 23-yard TD and Tetairoa McMillan on a seven-yard strike. Young will look to keep rolling in Week 12 against Tampa Bay.

injury.comment: Waddle secured three of six targets for 61 yards during Sunday's 38-24 win versus the Raiders.
injury.longComment: Waddle sustained a concussion in the Broncos' last game in Week 9 at Carolina, but with the benefit of a Week 10 bye, he had enough time to gain clearance from the protocol for head injuries and miss no additional time as a result. With a 24-yard connection with QB Bo Nix on Sunday, Waddle now has recorded exactly one catch of at least that distance in four straight games. Unfortunately for Waddle's fantasy managers, his 61 receiving yards marked his second most of the campaign after a 138-yard outburst in Week 2 against the Jaguars, so he remains an underwhelming asset in most formats.

tg.callText: [strong] He was a full participant in Wednesday's practice on Nov. 18, his first practice back from the bye after a Week 9 concussion, which puts him on track for Sunday against the Raiders, though reports haven't yet said he has cleared the concussion protocol. injury.comment: Nix completed 19 of 35 passes for 225 yards, one touchdown and one interception and notched six carries for five yards during Sunday's 38-24 victory against the Raiders.
injury.longComment: After a hit-or-miss first six appearances of the season, Nix has settled into a four-game stretch in which his passing yards have ranged from 222 to 237 weekly, a span in which he boasts a 6:2 TD:INT and 84 rushing yards and another score. He also displayed some promise with offseason acquisition Jaylen Waddle (3-61-0 on six targets) while connecting with TE Adam Trautman for his 12th touchdown pass in 10 contests. Nix will look to keep things rolling Friday at Pittsburgh.

injury.comment: Gordon rushed 11 times for 69 yards while catching two of three targets for minus-2 yards in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
injury.longComment: After a quiet first half, Gordon got free for a 24-yard run on the first possession of the second half to set up Miami's third and final field goal of the afternoon. Gordon was Miami's most effective offensive player as usual, as Kyle McCord threw for just 102 yards in the latter's second NFL start. This was Gordon's seventh consecutive game with at least 64 scrimmage yards, but he'll take a four-game touchdown drought into a Week 12 home game against the Jets.

injury.comment: Likely brought in one of three targets for 35 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Likely finished with season lows in reception and targets, although he did provide an impressive gain on his one catch. The breakout tight end was coming off a season-best 127-yard tally against the Commanders in Week 10, so Sunday's scant involvement can be described as an outlier. Despite the unremarkable performance, Likely still boasts a career-best 56-610-7 line across 10 games heading into a Week 12 road clash against the Colts next Sunday.

injury.comment: Ward completed 21 of 30 passes for 248 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing twice for three yards and another score in the Titans' 51-30 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
injury.longComment: Ward's final line belies his struggles somewhat, as a Cowboys defense that made a defensive playcaller switch brought him down for five sacks and forced a lost fumble on one of them at Dallas' 20-yard line. Ward did manage to connect with Carnell Tate (59 yards) and Calvin Ridley (12 yards) for his pair of TD passes, the first coming when the rookie wideout alertly got up after not being touched and the second on a broken play where Ward threw across the field after buying several extra seconds with his legs. Ward also had a one-yard touchdown run in the third quarter, and despite Tennessee's team-level misery, the second-year signal-caller has thrown for at least 231 yards and two touchdowns in three consecutive games heading into a Week 12 road matchup against the Jaguars next Sunday.

injury.comment: Jeanty tallied 11 carries for 79 yards and gathered in five of eight targets for 90 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 38-24 loss at Denver.
injury.longComment: Jeanty's 169 yards from scrimmage amounted to the second-highest single-game total of his career after going for 188 such yards against the Texans in Week 16 of last season. His performance was fueled by a 68-yard catch and run for a touchdown and a 46-yard rush, the latter of which marked his first of 20-plus yards on the campaign. Jeanty also broke a streak of four straight contests falling short of 10 carries, but considering No. 2 RB Mike Washington also earned nine runs in Week 11, the Raiders backfield remains a committee ahead of next Sunday's outing at Cleveland.

injury.comment: Tate brought in two of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Titans' 51-30 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Tate had a fairly non-descript day overall despite the Titans' 30-point output, but he rewarded fantasy managers with a 59-yard catch-and run touchdown in the third quarter on which he alertly got up and ran down the left sideline after Cowboys defenders failed to touch him while he was down. The rookie fourth overall pick was making his return from a two-game absence due to a shoulder injury, and the score served as Tate's second of his career, both which have come in his last three games. Tate has at least 58 receiving yards in five of the last six contests, including in three straight, heading into a Week 12 road matchup against the Jaguars next Sunday.

tg.callText: [strong] He's listed Questionable, but on Sunday morning (Nov 22, 2026) Ian Rapoport reported he's expected to play against Dallas; that follows a Nov 21 CBS report from Matt Zenitz that he's likely to return, after missing two games with the shoulder injury.

injury.comment: Rodgers completed 30 of 44 passes for 227 yards and one touchdown while rushing five times for 29 yards in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
injury.longComment: Rodgers threw a 20-yard touchdown pass to Max Hurleman on Pittsburgh's final offensive play with 1:21 remaining in the fourth quarter, but that was too little too late, as the Eagles proceeded to run out the clock to drop the Steelers to 6-4. Hurleman stepped up down the stretch in his first NFL game after starting wide receiver DK Metcalf was disqualified. Rodgers had a four-game stretch in which he threw 11 touchdown passes while posting at least 235 passing yards in each outing, but he has failed to reach that yardage total in any of his last four starts while recording only four TDs during the latter stretch. Snapping out of this recent funk won't be easy for Rodgers against the stout Broncos defense Friday.

injury.comment: Monangai carried the ball eight times for 18 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.
injury.longComment: Making his return from a five-game absence due to turf toe, Monangai wasn't able to generate much offense, as D'Andre Swift led the backfield with 15 touches and 59 scrimmage yards, plus a short receiving TD. Surprisingly, Salvon Ahmed also handled six carries, all in the fourth quarter when the game seemed well in hand. Monangai should see his usage increase as he puts the injury further behind him, and a late lost fumble by Swift -- his third of the season, a new career high -- might encourage coach Ben Johnson to prioritize Monangai even more in Week 12 against the Lions.

He left the Week 10 game against the Bills in the first quarter after multiple players landed on him and seemingly struggled to put weight on it. injury.comment: Mayfield completed 20 of 33 passes for 187 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed six times for 36 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Tampa Bay.
injury.longComment: Mayfield fought through foot and thumb injuries to take the field in a critical game for the 3-6 Buccaneers, but he wasn't able to keep pace with Jared Goff and Jahmyr Gibbs. Mayfield did throw multiple touchdown passes for the first time this season, hitting rookie Ted Hurst for scoring strikes of 23 and four yards. Mayfield's rushing yardage total was also a new season high, and he'll next take aim at the Panthers' beatable secondary in a Week 12 divisional home matchup on Monday night, Nov. 30.

tg.callText: [strong] NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reported on Sun Nov 22 that Mayfield will play against the Lions, after he went from missing Wednesday's practice to limited on Thursday and Friday.

injury.comment: Etienne carried the ball 14 times for 76 yards and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 21-13 loss to Chicago.
injury.longComment: The former Jaguar was the clear No. 1 option in the backfield for the Saints. Alvin Kamara saw just two touches and CJ Donaldson handled five, although Kamara did vulture another red-zone TD on a one-yard reception in the second quarter, Most of Etienne's production came on a 46-yard scamper that saw him tackled just short of the goal line, setting up Kamara's score, but the fact that he was able to produce his first big play as a Saint was still encouraging. Etienne will attempt to build on this performance in Week 12 against the Bengals.

injury.comment: Metcalf won't receive a suspension after he was ejected from Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles, but the NFL is still reviewing discipline for the receiver that could include a fine, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
injury.longComment: Metcalf was disqualified with 4:53 remaining in the third quarter Sunday after he attempted to poke Eagles defensive back Cooper DeJean in the eye. He was flagged for unsportsmanlike conduct in what was his second major transgression of the game; Metcalf previously drew an unnecessary roughness penalty in the first half, when he held his block of DeJean well after a play had finished. Though Metcalf won't miss further game action as a result of his ejection, he may have already lost the faith of his fantasy managers heading into a Week 12 matchup with the Broncos on Friday. Metcalf has hauled in just 36 of his 74 targets (48.6 percent catch rate) and has scored just two touchdowns on the season while topping 60 receiving yards in only two of his 10 appearances.

injury.comment: Flournoy caught just one pass for 11 yards on one target in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans.
injury.longComment: The Cowboys' slot receiver drew just one look on Dak Prescott's 33 pass attempts. He'd caught multiple passes in all 10 games leading up to Sunday's contest. A favorite target of Prescott in the red zone, Flournoy will try to rebound at home against the Eagles on Thanksgiving, when he'll be playable on three-game fantasy slates for Thursday.

injury.comment: Brissett completed 24 of 37 passes for 276 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers. He added seven rushing yards on two carries.
injury.longComment: It was another decent showing for the veteran quarterback, and his first TD pass in two games as a Raven came on a trick that involved a direct snap to Derrick Henry, who flipped it Brissett for a 52-yard strike to Rashod Bateman. Brissett has also kept Zay Flowers relevant, feeding the wideout 18 targets for a 14-171-0 line. Baltimore's passing attack will try to keep improving in Week 12 against the Texans.

injury.comment: Hampton carried the ball 14 times for 89 yards and caught his only target for four yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
injury.longComment: While he's still not seeing a consistent bell-cow workload, Hampton has turned his season around over the last three games, racking up 254 rushing yards and a TD while averaging 5.2 yards per carry. Keaton Mitchell left Sunday's game early with a knee injury, but his absence appeared to provide a bigger boost to Kimani Vidal, who wound up logging nine touches and 54 scrimmage yards. Hampton will look to keep rolling in Week 12 against the Patriots.

injury.comment: Tyson caught one of two targets for six yards and added four rushing yards on his only carry in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
injury.longComment: One week after logging 13 targets as Tyler Shough's top downfield option, Tyson all but disappeared as Chris Olave instead saw WR1-worthy volume. The Saints' aerial attack simply may not be able to support both wideouts in the same game, which would mark Tyson as a volatile, but high-ceiling, fantasy asset for the rest of the season. The rookie will try to bounce back in Week 12 against the Bengals.

injury.comment: Egbuka brought in two of five targets for 18 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Egbuka couldn't do much despite tying for the second-most targets on the afternoon for the Buccaneers. The 2025 first-round pick's catch total tied his season low, and he also posted his third sub-20-yard tally of the season. Egbuka has now been held under 50 receiving yards in five consecutive contests heading into a Week 12 Monday night home showdown against the Panthers on Nov. 30.

injury.comment: Herbert entered the concussion protocol after Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.
injury.longComment: Herbert completed 15 of 21 passes for 131 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions in Week 11, but he also endured six sacks, fumbled once and added 32 yards and one TD on his eight carries. It's unclear exactly when he picked up the head injury, but he'll be subject to the concussion protocol ahead of further game action. The Chargers take the field next Sunday against the Patriots.

injury.comment: Kamara rushed one time for one yard and caught a one-yard touchdown on two targets in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
injury.longComment: The veteran running back played just eight of 72 offensive snaps, while both CJ Donaldson and Travis Etienne played 32 each with Audric Estime a healthy inactive. Kamara has touched the ball just seven times on 24 snaps over the past two weeks, but he's turned three of those touches into short touchdowns. The Saints' three-man backfield continues to be one to try and avoid when making fantasy lineup decisions. Kamara's proverbial gas tank is nearing empty, but the Saints continue to give him high-value touches near the goal line while refusing to play him outside of the red zone.

injury.comment: Dowdle rushed five times for 15 yards and caught four of five targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
injury.longComment: Dowdle finished with 34 scrimmage yards for a second consecutive game after racking up 235 scrimmage yards over his preceding four appearances. He had five more yards than Jaylen Warren on two fewer touches in Sunday's loss. Dowdle is poised to retain his spot as the 1B option alongside Warren in Friday's Week 12 home game against the Broncos.

injury.comment: Shakir caught five of nine targets for 101 yards while rushing twice for two yards in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
injury.longComment: Shakir led the Bills in receiving yards in the absence of TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle), posting 10 more than DJ Moore, who had one more target than Shakir. Sunday marked Shakir's first time reaching the 100-yard threshold since a 110-yard showing in Week 12 of last season. Shakir will look to build on this outing as he searches for his second TD of the season Thursday against the Chiefs.

injury.comment: Downs brought in four of five targets for 59 yards in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Playing in his second game as a member of the Chiefs, Downs posted four receptions for the second consecutive contest and upped his receiving yardage total by six over that of his team debut. Downs' quick chemistry with Patrick Mahomes is certainly noteworthy and makes an already impressive air attack all the more effective heading into Thursday night's Thanksgiving road showdown against the Bills.

injury.comment: Loveland caught all three of his targets for 29 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.
injury.longComment: While he didn't get much target volume, Loveland was still able to make an impact with a 15-yard TD reception in the second quarter that saw him hurdle a defender without even breaking stride on his way to the end zone. It was the tight end's third score of the season, all of which have come during Chicago's current five-game win streak, and after a slow start to the season Loveland has delivered a 27-282-3 line on 37 targets during that period. He'll look to keep rolling in Week 12 against the Lions.

injury.comment: Mendoza was 18-for-37 passing for 267 yards, three touchdowns and one interception and had four carries for 22 yards during Sunday's 38-24 loss in Denver.
injury.longComment: After throwing for no touchdowns or interceptions in his first NFL start last Sunday against the Seahawks, Mendoza recorded the first scoring strike of his career on a 68-yard catch and run via RB Ashton Jeanty in Week 11. Mendoza also hooked up with Ian Thomas (19 yards) and Jack Bech (seven yards) for his other two TDs, but he followed up a 58.6 completion percentage in Week 10 with more misfires (19) than connections (18) this Sunday. Mendoza's next chance for game action is next Sunday at Cleveland.

injury.comment: Gainwell rushed four times for 16 yards and brought in four of five targets for 43 yards in the Buccaneers 31-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Gainwell held his usual complementary role on the ground behind a busy Bucky Irving, yet with the Buccaneers trailing throughout the second half, Gainwell was able to finish second in receptions, receiving yards and targets on the day for Tampa Bay. The veteran back has back-to-back 16-yard efforts on the ground, but Gainwell has a combined 7-103-0 line through the air in that same span heading into a Week 12 home matchup against the Panthers on Monday night, Nov. 30.

injury.comment: Washington turned nine carries into 42 yards during Sunday's 38-24 defeat in Denver.
injury.longComment: With only seven targets and four catches through 11 games to begin his career, Washington requires volume on the ground to produce, which is difficult to come by in a backfield led by Ashton Jeanty. And Jeanty was the engine of the Raiders offense Sunday, racking up 16 touches for 169 yards from scrimmage and one receiving TD. A rookie fourth-rounder, Washington is averaging just 3.9 yards per carry and has scored only one touchdown ahead of next Sunday's road matchup with the Browns.

injury.comment: McConkey caught five of eight targets for 37 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
injury.longComment: His longest gain went for just 11 yards, but McConkey was deadly in the red zone, connecting with Justin Herbert on scores of 11 and six yards in the fourth quarter as the Chargers tried to mount a late comeback. Herbert was placed in the concussion protocol after the game after taking six sacks, and if he end up missing any time, it would put a big damper on McConkey's fantasy outlook with undrafted rookie DJ Uiagalelei being the Bolts' backup, unless Trey Lance (groin) is able to return from IR. McConkey has had plenty of trouble staying on the field himself this year, of course, and he'll take a 22-323-3 line on 32 targets through seven contests into a Week 12 clash with the Patriots.

injury.longComment: Smith didn't have a completion longer than 21 yards but kept the offense on schedule with an accurate performance. Most importantly, he stepped up in the red zone, which has been the team's Achilles' heel throughout the season. Smith threw a seven-yard touchdown pass to Breece Hall to snap the Jets' two-game touchdown drought in the second quarter, then tacked on touchdown passes of eight and 15 yards to practice-squad elevation Sterling Shepard. The veteran QB will take a 15:3 TD:INT into a Week 12 road game against the Dolphins, who defeated the Jets in Week 7 despite three touchdown passes from Smith.

injury.comment: Johnson rushed once for two yards and caught seven of his eight targets for 55 yards in the Bills' 26-9 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Johnson did not carry the rock much at all in the contest. The running back did however rank third in Buffalo receiving yards behind Khalil Shakir (101) and DJ Moore (91).  Johnson should continue to see receiving opportunities in Week 12 against the Chiefs as the Bills' preferred third-down back.

injury.comment: Allen rushed 16 times for 75 yards while catching his lone target for nine yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
injury.longComment: Allen's 16 carries matched his total from the previous two games combined, as he had seen a downtick in opportunities since fellow RB Breece Hall returned from a quadriceps injury. Hall led the backfield once again with 100 scrimmage yards and a touchdown on 23 touches, but Allen was a key part of the game plan as well in the run-heavy win. The Jets will face a one-win team for a second consecutive game in Week 12 at Miami, which could allow Allen to stay involved alongside Hall.

injury.comment: Allgeier carried the ball seven times for 23 yards in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City.
injury.longComment: Game script fairly quickly put the Cardinals' running game in mothballs, and Allgeier wound up splitting the backfield workload nearly equally with Bam Knight, who picked up 45 scrimmage yards on eight touches. Allgeier has gone three straight games without reaching 50 rushing yards or getting into the end zone, but those games were also against very tough opponents (the Seahawks in Week 9 and the Rams in Week 10). The fifth-year RB could find a little more running room in Week 12 against the Commanders, but Jeremiyah Love (ankle) might also be ready to rejoin the lineup by then.

injury.comment: Mitchell caught two passes for 30 yards on three targets in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
injury.longComment: Even with Omar Cooper (ankle) and Isaiah Williams (ribs) inactive, Mitchell's role didn't change, as his three targets tied with two other teammates for second on the team behind Garrett Wilson's five on a day the Jets called 37 run plays to just 22 passes. Mitchell has just one touchdown this season and has only 14 catches for 212 yards and no touchdowns in six games surrounding his 7-142-1 receiving performance from Week 8 against the Raiders. He's a big-play specialist in an offense that prefers to feed Wilson and its running backs.

injury.comment: Washington caught three of six targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills. He rushed two times for 11 yards.
injury.longComment: Washington's six targets were third on the team, trailing Caleb Douglas (10) and Greg Dulcich (seven) on a day when Kyle McCord attempted 33 passes. Washington has just one touchdown this season and has yet to reach 70 receiving yards in any game in 2026. There's not much to like about the wideout's fantasy prospects moving forward this season.

injury.comment: McCarthy completed 18 of 38 passes for 173 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions and rushed seven times for 33 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
injury.longComment: McCarthy had his share of trouble against an aggressive Jaguars defense, leading to a season-worst 47.4 percent completion rate. However, the emerging signal-caller avoided turnovers and connected with Malik Nabers for an eight-yard touchdown pass in the second quarter. McCarthy also provided some timely contributions with his legs, and he's averaging 5.4 yards on his 22 rush attempts to date. McCarthy connected with nine different targets overall as he continues to show good command of the offense, and he'll look to bounce back efficiency-wise in a Week 12 road matchup against the Colts next Sunday.

injury.comment: Singletary finished with one carry for five yards and one catch for five yards in Sunday's 23-18 win over the Jaguars.
injury.longComment: The running back played just 10 offensive snaps behind starter Cam Skattebo. Singletary has averaged just 2.9 yards per carry this year on 41 attempts.

injury.comment: Rodriguez rushed four times for 28 yards in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants. He added one catch for 13 yards on one target.
injury.longComment: With the Jaguars chasing points and playing from behind most of the afternoon, Bhayshul Tuten and Rodrgiuez combined for just 14 carries, while Trevor Lawrence dropped back to pass 50 times. Rodriguez's catch was just his fifth of the season, and he's handled single-digit carries in eight of 10 contests. He's merely an insurance policy behind Tuten in fantasy.

tg.callText: [strong] NBC Sports/Rotoworld (Nov 18): limited Wednesday with a hand injury he has played through for several weeks (10 carries, 2 catches in Week 9). NBC expects this week to be no different. Based only on Wednesday's report.

injury.comment: Tucker caught two of 10 targets for 50 yards during Sunday's 38-24 loss to the Broncos.
injury.longComment: Tucker finished with a team-high 10 targets, but he was unable to get on the same page with quarterback Fernando Mendoza for the majority of the game. Most of the wide receiver's production came on a 39-yard catch in the fourth quarter, and he has now combined to reel in three of 12 targets for 59 yards over Mendoza's first two career starts.

injury.comment: Bernard caught six passes for 40 yards on 10 targets in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
injury.longComment: With Michael Pittman (foot) remaining sidelined for Week 11, Bernard retained his every-down role on offense, playing 67 of 71 offensive snaps while leading the team in routes (52) and targets. It was a nice bounce-back game for the rookie after he was held without a catch on three targets against the Bengals in Week 10. Pittman is expected back for Friday's game against the Broncos, but Bernard could keep pacing the team in playing time, especially if DK Metcalf gets disciplined for his latest on-field outburst.

injury.comment: Kincaid (thumb/ankle) was listed as a limited participant on Monday's practice estimate.
injury.longComment: Kincaid didn't practice at all last week before being made inactive for Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins. Though the Bills didn't actually practice Monday, Kincaid's 'limited' listing does represent an upgrade and suggests that the tight end has a chance to be available for Thursday night's game against the Chiefs. Further context regarding his Week 12 status is set to arrive via Tuesday's practice report, in any case.

injury.comment: Milton completed 11 of 21 passes for 141 yards while rushing five times for seven yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
injury.longComment: Milton has thrown for just 310 yards without a touchdown pass or interception through two starts. He rushed for just seven yards Sunday after notching 64 rushing yards against the Giants in his first start with the Eagles, but Milton avoided mistakes as the Eagles rode their defense and Saquon Barkley's legs to their third win of the season. Twelve of Milton's 21 passes were directed to DeVonta Smith (hamstring) in their first game together. Milton is poised to start on Thanksgiving against the Cowboys, with whom he appeared in four games last season. He was on Dallas' practice squad prior to signing with the Eagles in October.

injury.comment: Hill carried the ball six times for 69 yards and a touchdown and caught four of five targets for 27 yards in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
injury.longComment: Derrick Henry had a strong performance as well but was knocked out of the game in the fourth quarter and got checked for a concussion. Hill was heavily involved in the offense prior to that, however, scoring from 19 yards out in the late in the second quarter. He almost had a second TD earlier in the quarter, but Hill had the ball punched loose at the one-yard line after a 36-yard scamper and saw it bounce out of the end zone for a turnover and a touchback. Henry cleared the concussion protocol after the game and figures to be active in the Week 12 against the Texans, but Hill's usage appears to be on the upswing as the Ravens' No. 2 back.

injury.comment: Vidal carried the ball seven times for 36 yards and caught both his targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
injury.longComment: After handling just four touches last week against the Ravens, Vidal saw his usage increase again as he recorded his most scrimmage yards since Week 5. This time, however, his additional volume came at the expense of Keaton Mitchell (knee), who left the game early. Omarion Hampton has re-established himself as the Chargers' clear No. 1 RB over the last few contests, but if Mitchell's injury proves to be serious, Vidal could have some deeper-league appeal with the No. 2 role all to himself. He'll look to take advantage of whatever opportunities he gets in Week 12 against the Patriots.

injury.comment: Sutton didn't corral either of his two targets during Sunday's 38-24 victory versus the Raiders.
injury.longComment: Sutton thus was blanked in the box score for the first time Week 7 of the 2024 campaign, a span of 39 games (including playoffs). Considering he's surpassed 50 receiving yards just one time in 10 appearances in 2026, he doesn't hold much sway for fantasy purposes, especially in a Broncos offense that often has sputtered this season. Sutton's next chance to turn the tide arrives Friday at Pittsburgh.

injury.comment: Vele caught seven passes for 76 yards on seven targets in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
injury.longComment: Vele continues to run virtually every route for New Orleans, and the seven grabs matched his season high from Week 1 against the Lions, while Vele's 76 yards are a new high-water mark for the receiver. It was notable that Jordyn Tyson ran just 22 routes on Tyler Shough's 51 dropbacks against Chicago. The Saints offense has become tough to predict on a week-to-week basis. Vele is more of a low-ceiling fantasy WR4/5 most weeks.

injury.comment: Kelce brought in six of seven targets for 74 yards and two touchdowns in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Kelce tied for the team lead in receptions with Rashee Rice while setting the pace in both receiving yards and targets, and he posted his first multi-touchdown effort of the season in the process. The legendary tight end recorded his scoring grabs from eight and 22 yards out, and both his reception and yardage totals were his highest since Week 2. Kelce will take a 41-586-4 line into Thursday's Thanksgiving Day road showdown against the Bills.

injury.comment: Dobbins logged just one snap in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders, though head coach Sean Payton said Monday that Dobbins "is going to be super important" moving forward, Will Petersen of 104.3 The Fan reports.
injury.longComment: Dobbins' opportunities have been dwindling since Week 7 against Arizona, when he dropped to 14 offensive snaps after tallying 31 the week prior. That contest against the Cardinals was when rookie Jonah Coleman returned from a four-game absence, and Coleman has since forced his way into Denver's lead-RB role with blossoming production that has included five rushing TDs over his past three games. Coleman got nearly every running-back snap for Denver on Sunday, with practice-squad elevation Cody Schrader logging just two snaps and Dobbins one. Despite Payton's proclamation that Dobbins still has a "super important" role with the team, there's little reason to expect him to be a reliable fantasy asset as long as Coleman is healthy.

injury.comment: Abdomen
Odunze caught all four of his targets for 45 yards in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.
injury.longComment: The four grabs led the Bears on the afternoon, as the offense looked a little sluggish coming out of its bye. Odunze's longest gain went for just 19 yards, and rookie Zavion Thomas wound up leading the team in receiving yards thanks to a 40-yard connection with Caleb Williams in the third quarter. Odunze has caught exactly four passes in four straight games, a stretch in which he's produced a 16-261-1 line on 22 targets. The third-year wideout will try to get more involved in a potential Week 12 barn burner against the Lions.

injury.comment: Lemon caught one of three targets for three yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
injury.longComment: Lemon turned three targets into just three yards while DeVonta Smith (hamstring) paced the Eagles with 12 targets in the latter's return. In five games playing alongside Smith, Lemon has just 11 catches for 60 yards. Opportunities should be available against Dallas' porous secondary on Thanksgiving, but it remains to be seen if the unproven QB-WR combo of Joe Milton and Lemon can capitalize on that favorable matchup.

injury.comment: Goedert was listed as a limited participant in Monday's practice estimate due to a shin injury.
injury.longComment: Philadelphia gauged Goedert as a limited participant to kick off Week 12 prep after he played 47 of 53 snaps while turning his lone target into a 38-yard reception during Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers. Goedert won't have much time to heal up from the shin issue while the Eagles prepare for a Thursday matchup with the Cowboys, but the fact that he avoided being listed as a non-participant on the first injury report of the week is generally a good sign for his chances of being cleared for game day.

injury.comment: McCord completed 12 of 33 passes for 102 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills. He also rushed twice for nine yards.
injury.longComment: McCord has thrown for just 311 yards without a touchdown pass in his first two NFL starts. The 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles is poised to make at least two more starts while Malik Willis (abdomen) is on IR. Miami's lone win of the season came against the Jets, whom the Dolphins will host in Week 12.

injury.comment: Brooks (groin) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
injury.longComment: Brooks was a full practice participant in all three sessions during Week 11 prep. However, the third-year running back is not quite ready to be activated from injured reserve, and he's slated to miss his eighth consecutive game while recovering from a groin injury. Trevor Etienne, Anthony Tyus and AJ Dillon will continue to operate as the Panthers' backfield depth options behind Chuba Hubbard in the absence of Brooks, whose next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Buccaneers on Monday, Nov. 30.

injury.comment: The Titans placed Spears (knee) on injured reserve Saturday, Jim Wyatt of the Titans' official site reports.
injury.longComment: Spears was sidelined for Weeks 7 and 8 due to a knee injury but was cleared to play against the Jaguars in Week 10, when he turned four carries into 28 yards and failed to haul in his lone target. He was initially listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys after logging a full practice Friday, but the Titans have determined that a stint on injured reserve is warranted for the fourth-year running back. Spears will be required to miss at least the next four games, so his next chance to play is Week 15 against the Colts on Sunday, Dec. 20. Tony Pollard will continue to be the workhorse running back for the Titans while Julius Chestnut and rookie fifth-rounder Nicholas Singleton provide depth out of the backfield.

injury.comment: Vaki took one carry for a loss of one yard and caught his only target for seven yards during Sunday's 31-21 win versus the Buccaneers.
injury.longComment: Of the Lions' 58 offensive snaps in Week 11, Vaki played just 13, his lowest count since back in Week 7 versus the Packers (9). Starter Jahmyr Gibbs compiled 100-plus scrimmage yards and multiple scrimmage touchdowns for the fifth time in 10 games Sunday, so should continue to get all the work he can handle in a Thanksgiving matchup versus the Bears, leaving only whatever is left behind to Vaki.

injury.comment: Johnston caught one of two targets for nine yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets. He added one yard on one rushing attempt.
injury.longComment: Johnston was targeted on just 9.5 percent of Justin Herbert's 21 pass attempts against New York. The wideout has now caught exactly one pass in three straight games and in five of his last six contests. Johnston is a lightly targeted deep threat who will likely continue to see fewer looks if Ladd McConkey is able to maintain his health for an extended period.

injury.comment: Meyers brought in four of 10 targets for 85 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
injury.longComment: Meyers finished second across the board to Parker Washington in receptions, receiving yards and targets for the Jaguars on the afternoon, and the latter pair of totals also established and tied a season high, respectively. Meyers' yardage and reception tallies have fluctuated this season, but Sunday's performance underscores the fact he remains a key complementary piece of the Jaguars' typically efficient air attack. Meyers will look to exploit a favorable Week 12 matchup against the Titans defense at home next Sunday.

tg.callText: [strong] RotoWire and CBS Sports (Nov 18): limited Wednesday with the ankle injury. The Jaguars often limit him early in the week. He hasn't missed a game this year, including last week after missing Wednesday's practice. Based only on Wednesday's report.

injury.comment: Klubnik completed 11 of 20 passes for 137 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills. He added three rushing attempts for 26 yards.
injury.longComment: Klubnik saw the first regular-season action of his NFL career in the second half of Sunday's loss, as Geno Smith (ankle) exited the game. The rookie fourth-round pick led the offense down to Buffalo's four-yard line on his first possession in the third quarter, but the Jets settled for a field goal on that possession, and Klubnik was picked off on his next drive. If Smith isn't ready to return in Week 11, Klubnik would be in line to make his first regular-season start on the road against the Chargers.

injury.comment: Davis rushed one time for three yards and caught a six-yard pass on two targets in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
injury.longComment: Even with the Bills having a quick Week 12 turnaround ahead of Thursday night's game against the Chiefs on Thanksgiving, Buffalo rode James Cook and handed him 22 carries rather than spelling him a little more ahead of a short week. Davis has handled 17 carries across 10 games this season, turning them into a measly 55 yards and no touchdowns. His only fantasy value is being Cook's backup.

tg.callText: [lean] He was limited on Wednesday, Nov 18 with a hamstring injury, his first time on the injury report since a Week 8 illness, and CBS (Nov 18) said that unless he left practice early Davis should still have decent odds of being ready to play Sunday against the Dolphins.

injury.comment: Johnson (ankle) was listed as a non-participant on Monday's estimated practice report.
injury.longComment: The running back injured his ankle on kickoff coverage in the first quarter of Sunday's game against the Saints and had to be carted off. He'll have two more chances to get on the practice field ahead of Thursday's matchup with the Lions, but he does not appear likely to play at this point. D'Andre Swift and Kyle Monangai are healthy at the top of Chicago's running back depth chart.

injury.comment: Knight carried the ball seven times for 35 yards and caught his only target for 10 yards in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City.
injury.longComment: Although he split the backfield workload nearly equally with Tyler Allgeier, Knight was the more productive RB, although he still failed to reach 50 rushing yards for a fourth straight game. The 25-year-old running back gets a more favorable matchup in Week 12 against the Commanders, but Knight and Allgeier could face additional competition for touches if Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is cleared to return.

injury.comment: Douglas caught two of 10 targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
injury.longComment: Douglas paced the team in targets and receiving yards, but he struggled to get on the same page as QB Kyle McCord, who completed just 12 of 33 passes for 102 yards. The rookie WR didn't help his cause with a red-zone drop in the third quarter. In Week 12, Douglas will face a Jets secondary against which he scored twice in their Week 7 matchup. Those are the only two touchdowns of his seven-game regular-season career.

tg.callText: [strong] He was limited in Wednesday's (Nov. 18) practice with a shoulder injury and wore a red non-contact jersey, but the rookie wideout said afterward that he fully expects to play Sunday against the Bills, per the Miami Herald via RotoWire (Nov. 18).

injury.comment: Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said Monday that he's "very confident" Pittman (foot) will be on the field this week when the Steelers face the Broncos on Friday, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.
injury.longComment: Pittman was designated for return from IR this past Wednesday, but despite being listed as a full participant in practice Thursday and Friday, the Steelers elected to not activate the WR (who had been listed as questionable) for Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles. Added context regarding Pittman's status will arrive via Pittsburgh's next practice report, but barring any setbacks, it appears as though he's approaching his first game action since Week 4.

injury.comment: LaPorta (ankle) was limited at Monday's walkthrough, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.
injury.longComment: With a Thanksgiving matchup on tap against the Bears, the Lions are easing into the week following Sunday's 31-21 win against the Buccaneers, when LaPorta gathered in three of six targets for 62 yards. He's nursing an ankle issue in the wake of that contest, and he may need to be listed as full Tuesday and/or Wednesday in order to avoid a designation ahead of Thursday's game.

injury.comment: Winston carried twice for one yard in Thursday's 24-21 loss to the Commanders.
injury.longComment: J.J. McCarthy made his third consecutive start for the Giants, but Winston continued to get sprinkled into the game plan during short-yardage situations. He extended a second-quarter drive that culminated in a Cam Skattebo touchdown by gaining a yard on a fourth-and-one play, but Winston was dropped for no gain on a third-and-one run in the fourth quarter that resulted in a Giants punt. The Giants may continue to turn to Winston for quarterback sneaks in future weeks in an effort to limit the wear and tear on McCarthy.

injury.comment: Daniels is set for his usual role as Tampa Bay's backup quarterback Sunday versus Detroit, as Baker Mayfield (foot/thumb) is active and will start, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.
injury.longComment: Mayfield entered Sunday deemed questionable due to his injuries, but he's ultimately going to be able to suit up. As such, Daniels will retain his role as Mayfield's backup. Easton Stick (coach's decision) is serving as Tampa Bay's emergency third quarterback.

injury.comment: Hamstring
Estime (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Bears.
injury.longComment: Estime's role in the offense was reduced in Week 10 against the Panthers, which marked Travis Etienne's return from a five-game absence due to a hamstring injury. Estime is a healthy scratch for Sunday's game, which means Alvin Kamara and CJ Donaldson will operate as the rotational options out of the backfield behind Etienne. Estime's next opportunity to play is Week 12 against the Bengals on Nov. 29.

injury.comment: Coleman caught two of four targets for 17 yards during Sunday's 26-9 win over Miami.
injury.longComment: Coleman finished with fewer than 20 receiving yards for the fourth straight week, and he hasn't reached the end zone since Week 6. The wide receiver has operated in a limited role on offense since DJ Moore returned to action in Week 8 following a shoulder injury, and Coleman will remain an unattractive fantasy asset ahead of the team's matchup with the Chiefs on Thanksgiving night.

injury.comment: The Eagles placed Wicks (ankle/foot) on injured reserve Saturday.
injury.longComment: Wicks missed the three games before the Eagles' Week 10 bye due to an ankle injury, and he was limited during Week 11 prep before the team tacked on a foot issue on Friday's practice report, after which he was ruled out for Sunday's contest against the Steelers. Per Tim McManus of ESPN.com, Wicks sustained the foot injury Friday, and it presumably led to his placement on IR. Wicks will be sidelined until at least Philadelphia's Week 15 matchup with Seattle on Saturday, Dec. 19.

injury.comment: Mayer posted one catch (on four targets) for four yards during Sunday's 38-24 defeat at Denver.
injury.longComment: Mayer missed out on a prime opportunity with top TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quadriceps) inactive in Week 11. When Bowers was out in Weeks 1 and 2 as he recovered from a meniscus trim in his left knee, Mayer went for a combined 9-55-0 line on 11 targets in those contests, but the latter also missed a stretch in the fourth quarter this Sunday due to a back injury. Bowers' status will be worth monitoring this week, as an absence from him next Sunday in Cleveland will set up Mayer for another key chance to produce.

injury.comment: McKee (ribs) was estimated as a limited participant on Monday's injury report.
injury.longComment: It's unclear when McKee picked up the injury, given that he didn't play a single snap during Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers while serving as Joe Milton's backup. The Eagles have two more practices on a short week, so McKee's participation in those sessions will determine whether he'll be available against the Cowboys on Thanksgiving Day. Rookie fifth-rounder Cole Payton would serve as the QB2 behind Milton if McKee cannot play Thursday.

injury.comment: Foot
Mitchell (back) has re-entered Sunday's game against the Jets, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.
injury.longComment: Mitchell temporarily exited the contest in the first half due to a back issue. However, he's since returned to the game as part of the kickoff-return unit. Mitchell is thus set to resume his usual role as both a backup RB and special-teams ace.

injury.comment: Bryant caught three passes for 32 yards on four targets in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
injury.longComment: The wideout briefly exited the game in the third quarter after he appeared to tweak his previously injured ankle, but Bryant quickly returned and was able to finish out the contest. His four targets were fourth on the team on a day Bo Nix targeted nine different players on 35 pass attempts. The Denver offense spreads the ball around to five different receivers, three tight ends and its running backs most weeks, making it difficult for any of the pass catchers to post big numbers in the box score.

injury.comment: Godwin caught three passes for 18 yards on three targets in Sunday's 31-21 loss to the Lions.
injury.longComment: The veteran wideout ran a team-high 41 routes on Baker Mayfield's 44 dropbacks, but Godwin continues to produce very little with his immense playing time. He's been held under 40 receiving yards in eight straight games and has yet to have a 50-yard receiving game this season. Godwin also has zero touchdowns. He's a low-floor, low-ceiling fantasy option headed into next Monday night's date with the Panthers.

injury.comment: Shipley (foot/illness) was estimated as a limited participant on Monday's injury report.
injury.longComment: Shipley returned Sunday from a four-game absence due to a foot injury, and he finished that contest with four carries for nine yards and returned three kickoffs for 75 yards. He's still working through that foot issue, but he's now battling through an illness, so his practice participation over the next two days will be worth monitoring ahead of the Eagles' Thanksgiving Day contest against the Cowboys in Dallas. Shipley could operate in an elevated role on offense Thursday depending on the status of Saquon Barkley (neck/illness).
